stem_book: The moment of inertia of a non-uniform ring of mass m and radius R, about the axis through its centre and perpendicular to its plane, will be : (a) greater than mR² (b) less than mR² (c) may be less than or greater than mR² (d) equal to mR²
reason: axis (central, perpendicular to plane) is implied by the print; added to the stem so (c) cannot be argued for a diameter.
work: every element at R regardless of distribution: I = ∫R² dm = mR²
